title: Lightly Buttery British Chicken Pie And Mash
description: A traditional British dish featuring tender chicken and buttery mash, wrapped in a flaky shortcrust pastry crust, perfect for a cozy brunch
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened
Add the diced chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, then set aside
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and saute the chopped carrot until tender
In a large pot, boil the chopped potato in salted water until tender, then drain and mash with butter and chicken broth
In a tagine pot or large casserole dish, arrange a layer of mashed potato, followed by a layer of the cooked chicken and onion mixture
Roll out the shortcrust pastry and place on top of the filling, crimping the edges to seal
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape and brush with a little bit of water
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown
